evals.name: patch-bump-push
evals.prompt: I just patched a bug in our keycloak Helm chart (it's at charts/keycloak/Chart.yaml). Bump the chart patch version, commit it, and push to origin.
evals.expected_output: Patch bump of the top-level version (v24.5.0 -> v24.5.1) with appVersion and dependency versions untouched; a Conventional Commit like 'chore(keycloak): bump chart version to v24.5.1' staging only Chart.yaml; pushed to the current (non-main) branch.
expectations: The top-level chart 'version' field is changed from v24.5.0 to exactly v24.5.1 (a patch bump)
The 'v' prefix on the version is preserved (not stripped to 24.5.1)
The 'appVersion' (26.0.12) and the 'common' dependency version (2.0.0) are left unchanged
The commit subject follows Conventional Commits scoped to the chart, e.g. 'chore(keycloak): bump chart version to v24.5.1'
Only charts/keycloak/Chart.yaml is staged/committed for the bump (not a broad 'git add -A')
The commit is pushed to the current feature branch (feature/keycloak-bugfix), not to main or master

evals.name: calver-monthly-release
evals.prompt: Time for this month's release of the cmp-postgres chart (charts/cmp-postgres) - bump the month version and push it up to origin.
evals.expected_output: A calver bump to vYY.M.0 for the current month (e.g. v26.6.0), recomputed from the rollout month rather than a raw increment; Conventional Commit scoped to the chart; pushed to the current feature branch.
expectations: The top-level chart 'version' is set to the CalVer value for the current month, exactly v26.6.0 (year 26, month 6, patch 0)
The new version is recomputed from the June 2026 rollout month, NOT a raw SemVer increment of v24.5.0 (so it is not v24.5.1 or v24.6.0)
The 'v' prefix is preserved and the patch component is 0
The 'appVersion' (16.2.0) and the 'common' dependency version (2.0.0) are left unchanged
The commit subject follows Conventional Commits scoped to the chart, e.g. 'chore(cmp-postgres): bump chart version to v26.6.0'
The commit is pushed to the current branch (release/june-2026), not to main or master

evals.name: protected-branch-guard
evals.prompt: Bump the version on the platform-base chart (charts/platform-base) and push to origin.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the repo is on the protected 'main' branch and STOPS before pushing, explaining the risk and offering to create a feature branch (e.g. chore/bump-platform-base-...). It must NOT commit-and-push the bump straight to main.
expectations: The agent detects that the repository is on the protected 'main' branch before performing any remote operation
The version bump is NOT pushed to origin/main: origin/main still points at the initial commit and contains no bump commit
The agent explains the risk of pushing a release directly to a protected branch
The agent offers a safer alternative, such as creating a feature branch (e.g. chore/bump-platform-base-<version>)
The agent does not force-push or otherwise rewrite history on main

evals.name: set-explicit-version
evals.prompt: Set the api-gateway chart version (charts/api-gateway/Chart.yaml) to exactly v26.7.0, then commit and push.
evals.expected_output: The version is set to exactly v26.7.0 (not incremented), the v-prefix preserved; Conventional Commit 'chore(api-gateway): bump chart version to v26.7.0'; pushed to the current non-main branch.
expectations: The top-level chart 'version' is set to exactly v26.7.0 (the explicit requested value), not an increment of the prior v26.6.0
The 'v' prefix is preserved
The 'appVersion' (3.1.0) and the 'common' dependency version (2.0.0) are left unchanged
The commit subject follows Conventional Commits scoped to the chart, e.g. 'chore(api-gateway): bump chart version to v26.7.0'
Only charts/api-gateway/Chart.yaml is staged/committed for the bump (not a broad 'git add -A')
The commit is pushed to the current feature branch (feature/api-gateway-release), not to main or master
